items.q: Do you disclose that content is AI-generated?
items.a: Yes. We label synthetic content per platform policy and applicable regulation. Every dedicated AI influencer profile carries a clear 'AI' disclosure, and we advise clients on captions and platform-specific tags. See our AI Content & Disclosure page.

items.q: How do you keep a character consistent across posts?
items.a: Each recurring character is defined by a locked reference set and prompt system, so the same face, styling, and vibe carry across every asset and format.

items.q: What about likeness rights for AI influencers?
items.a: AI personas are original and do not depict real people without a signed likeness license. Our internal influencer library blocks any persona with a missing or expired license from being assigned.

items.q: Which languages and dialects do you cover?
items.a: Native Arabic (MSA and major dialects) and English, produced together — not translated as an afterthought.

items.q: Can I white-label this for my agency?
items.a: Yes. The Custom tier includes reseller terms, multi-brand pipelines, and delivery under your brand.
Phase 1 is static imagery and carousels. Video is on the roadmap; the catalog and pricing are built to add it without a rebuild.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: What we collect
Contact details you submit through our intake form (name, company, email, WhatsApp), any brand assets you upload, and standard analytics about how you use the site.
How we use it
To respond to your enquiry, produce and deliver contracted work, send invoices, and improve our service. We do not sell your data.
Storage & security
Data is stored in Supabase (Postgres + Storage). Uploaded assets are held in a private bucket and served only through short-lived signed URLs. Access is restricted by row-level security.
Your rights
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.
Contact
For any privacy request, email the address on our Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
body: Scope
These terms govern content services provided by APEXSCALE, including static imagery, carousels, recurring AI characters, and dedicated AI influencers.
Deliverables & revisions
Each order specifies a deliverable scope and a contractual revision limit, visible in your dashboard. Additional revisions beyond the limit may incur fees.
Approvals
Production begins only after you approve the concept. Approved concepts define the scope of the work.
Ownership & licensing
On full payment you receive a license to use the delivered assets for the agreed purpose. AI personas remain the property of APEXSCALE unless otherwise agreed in writing.
AI content
All content is AI-generated and disclosed as such per our AI Content & Disclosure policy and applicable platform rules.
Liability
Services are provided on a commercial-reasonable-efforts basis; our liability is limited to the fees paid for the affected order.

disclosure.title: AI Content & Disclosure
disclosure.intro: Transparency about synthetic media is core to how we operate. This page explains what we make with AI and how we label it.
body: Everything we produce is AI-generated
Our imagery, characters, influencers, and ambassadors are created with generative AI. They do not depict real events and, unless a signed likeness license exists, do not depict real people.
How we label it

We follow each platform's synthetic-media policy and applicable regulation. Dedicated AI influencer profiles carry a clear 'AI-generated' disclosure, and we advise clients on captions, tags, and platform 'AI-generated' toggles.
Likeness & rights
AI personas are original. We never recreate a real person's likeness without a signed license. Internally, any persona with a missing or expired license is blocked from being assigned to work.
Prohibited uses

We do not produce content that impersonates real individuals without consent, spreads misinformation, or targets protected categories. Permitted and forbidden brand categories are enforced per persona.
Your responsibilities
Clients are responsible for adding platform-required disclosures when publishing, in line with local advertising standards. We provide guidance on request.
